LanguageData.SAU_Description: Individual garment replacement diagnostics. Auto mode defaults OFF. Only verified improvements with preserved coverage and ordinary gear are eligible. Gameplay compatibility remains unverified.
LanguageData.SAU_Auto: Automatically order idle pawns to upgrade (opt-in)
LanguageData.SAU_Excluded: Excluded comparisons - policy {0}, durability {1}, access {2}, quality {3}
LanguageData.SAU_PreferSame: Prioritize same type and material in diagnostics and automatic orders
LanguageData.SAU_Profile: Removed garment aggregate → candidate: max quality {0}→{1} (0–6); max condition {2}%→{3}%; summed raw score {4}→{5}
LanguageData.SAU_Partial: Partial: stock/comparison/path budget reached. Only individually verified candidates may be ordered after live rechecking. Unchecked entries never issue orders.
LanguageData.SAU_Failed: Scan failed; earlier results are stale. No automatic orders.
LanguageData.SAU_Stale: Settings changed or no snapshot. Rescan; automatic operation has a grace interval after load/settings changes.
LanguageData.SAU_Patched: Diagnostics only: apparel management method has Harmony patches.
LanguageData.SAU_InspectionFailed: Diagnostics only: patch inspection could not establish safety.
LanguageData.SAU_ReasonUnknown: Unknown or target changed; no automatic order
LanguageData.SAU_ReasonForced: Would replace forced or non-droppable apparel
LanguageData.SAU_ReasonRequirement: Conflicts with an apparel requirement or removes a required garment
LanguageData.SAU_ReasonMultiple: Would remove more than the one compared garment; diagnostics only
LanguageData.SAU_ReasonCoverage: Body-part groups or layers differ; diagnostics only
LanguageData.SAU_ReasonInvalid: Invalid/non-finite score or stat; cannot establish improvement
LanguageData.SAU_ReasonCondition: Condition below minimum or worse than current garment
LanguageData.SAU_ReasonRegression: Protection, insulation, mass, maximum hit points or wear rate would regress
LanguageData.SAU_ReasonGain: Insufficient raw-score gain or nonpositive vanilla net gain
LanguageData.SAU_ReasonForbidden: Candidate is forbidden or outside allowed access
LanguageData.SAU_ReasonReserved: Cannot reserve candidate (reservation or another eligibility restriction)
LanguageData.SAU_ReasonUnverified: Reachability not checked due to budget; no automatic order
LanguageData.SAU_ReasonCrossType: Different type/material: special effects unverified; diagnostics only
LanguageData.SAU_ReasonManager: Another apparel manager/patch controls outfits; diagnostics only
LanguageData.SAU_ReasonBusy: Manual/queued/useful job, sleep, injury, drafting, mental state or threat; defer
LanguageData.SAU_ReasonEligible: Eligible after sampled checks; auto must be explicitly enabled
LanguageData.SAU_ReasonOrdered: Vanilla Wear job ordered; actual completion is not confirmed
LanguageData.SAU_ReasonSpecial: Special components, abilities or changed equipped-stat offsets: cannot establish safe replacement; diagnostics only
LanguageData.SAU_ReasonUnknownQuality: At least one quality is unavailable; no automatic order
LanguageData.SAU_ReasonExtraSlot: Additional slot, with no garment to upgrade; shown for diagnosis only
